constraints.text: sent <= held: the unconfirmed batch stays in the outbox
done <= shown: mail is marked read only after it was shown
faulted = zfalse => lostRest = {}: after a partial read the remainder is reachable by a drain
faulted = zfalse => at most one copy of a message in relay and outbox

moreTruth <= moreOut <= moreTruth + moreSlack: more never undercounts and overcounts only by the timed-out-but-landed refiles outstanding (exact when moreSlack = 0); not covered at runtime: the lower bound when the relay backlog count fails (more then leaves it out)
issued <= shown + drained + relay + outbox + lost: nothing vanishes unaccounted
ReadFetch: a consuming fetch removes what it returns from the relay
ReadReply: the remainder is filed back under a derived id; held' = batch
ReadReplyRefused: a refused refile leaves the remainder in the outbox for the next read, and more counts it once
Confirm: the confirmation releases the batch from the outbox and marks it read
ReadCancelled (flag cancelled): a read cancelled between refiles leaves each message in the relay or the outbox, never both (goal cancelled & overlap unreachable)
ReadFetch: a fetched message that is the refile of a held one replaces it (held keeps one copy per message)
ReadReplyTimedOut (flag refileTimedOut): a refile that landed but timed out leaves copy and original, read once afterwards; the fetch reconciles them
EF dupShown: a batch shown and not confirmed is offered again (at least once)

limitsWithoutTest.text: EF lostBatch /= {} with no fault: SessionEnd discards an unconfirmed, unshown batch held in the outbox
limitsWithoutTest.reason: describes a defect, and a test would pin it; hard requirement of A2 (session end through the daemon refiles the held batch); the crash window and the fetch-to-refile window are PL-1753

limitsWithoutTest.text: EF moreOut > moreTruth: after a timed-out refile more overcounts, by at most moreSlack (held messages whose filed copy is already in the relay); it never undercounts; the next read reconciles it
limitsWithoutTest.reason: a stated bound, checked in the model (9,155 states, exhaustive); the code-side overcount is the double count of a landed copy and a held remainder, which no test exercises
